meta.frequency_caveat: Band edges are a post-hoc interpretive lens; the model never saw a band definition (XAI_PLAN.md 9.1).
meta.width_caveat: dBA rises with width for trivial reasons. Compare bands only WITHIN a width, and against power_removed_frac.

meta.scope_caveat: 0.832 here vs 0.435 leak-free; recid=0.920. Findings are Tier E candidates, not biomarkers.
